2026_02_NYG_LA.headline: Rams Look to Bounce Back Against Giants on Monday Night
2026_02_NYG_LA.paragraph1: The Los Angeles Rams and New York Giants meet on Monday Night Football, with both teams looking to build on their Week 1 performances. The Rams were dominated by the 49ers in Australia, while the Giants cruised to a 28-20 win over the Cowboys. The key matchup will be the Rams' explosive offense against the Giants' pass rush, led by Abdul Carter, who had five pressures against Dallas. The Giants' ability to control the line of scrimmage and sustain long drives will be crucial in slowing down the Rams' offense.
